scripts.build:latest: yarn run build:docker && yarn run tag:latest
scripts.build:commit: git add package.json yarn.lock && git commit -m "build(docker): version ${npm_package_version}"
scripts.build:patch: yarn version --patch --no-git-tag-version && yarn run build:latest && yarn run build:commit
scripts.build:minor: yarn version --minor --no-git-tag-version && yarn run build:latest && yarn run build:commit
scripts.build:major: yarn version --major --no-git-tag-version && yarn run build:latest && yarn run build:commit
scripts.push:docker: yarn run push:version && yarn run push:latest
scripts.publish: yarn run build:docker && yarn run push:docker
scripts.publish:patch: yarn run build:patch && yarn run push:docker
scripts.publish:minor: yarn run build:minor && yarn run push:docker
scripts.publish:major: yarn run build:major && yarn run push:docker
